value.rationale: This solves a natural physically motivated observability problem beyond static covariance: all time correlations can hide strictly positive dissipation precisely for sensor planes containing the rotational axis; periodic half-turn sensing erases the time arrow even with every state coordinate. The iff classification, closed KL response/visibility fraction and non-Markov reversible realization distinguish a structural information loss phenomenon from routine equal-time moment formulas. No claim is made for other noise symmetries or for full path EPR equal to pairwise KL slope.
